integrity: The proof is analytic. The imported deterministic stabilizer-Renyi monotonicity theorem and the stabilizer-work definition were checked against the cited primary full texts; no numerical experiment is used as proof.
scientific_limitations: Only finite-qubit pure states and deterministic pure-state stabilizer protocols are covered.
No strong or branch-average measurement monotonicity is claimed.
Mixed states, arbitrary stabilizer-preserving channels, negative or nonsummable mixtures, and the singular beta=0 partition-function ratio are outside scope.
title: Positive Pauli-moment mixtures generate pure-state magic monotones
